description: After Anthony ate at a restaurant without confirming the dish was gluten-free, he developed abdominal pain and bloating that lasted through the following day.
Anthony felt chest tightness and shortness of breath during a brisk uphill walk and had to stop and rest. The cardiologist advised keeping walking sessions on flat ground and at a moderate pace.
Anthony completed his cardiology follow-up with a stable ECG. Preventive aspirin after breakfast is well tolerated with no gastric discomfort reported.
